lines.text: The promise of entering God's rest still stands, and those who have believed enter that rest.
God rested from all His works on the sixth day, and those who first heard the good news did not enter because of disobedience.
A long time later, God spoke through David and said not to harden your hearts if you hear His voice Today.
If Moses had given them rest, God would not have spoken later about another day, so a Sabbath rest remains.
We must make every effort to enter that rest, and God's living word judges the thoughts and intentions of the heart.
